traps.label: wrong_site_or_stage

traps.label: no_derivation_route
traps.route: Normal urine contains no plasma protein. Protein in urine is a sign of kidney damage, not the reason urine is acidic.

ratings.reason: This question requires deciding which mechanism accounts for a granted fact, demonstrated by the stem's "Human urine is usually acidic because:", which grants the acidity and asks only for its cause.

group_note: Five of the six are `plain_mcq`; q091 is the exception and is `statement_options`, because its stem is only the trailing "because:" and each option is a full sentence to be judged. That also sets q091's E2 apart - `pick_cause_or_effect`, a rival cause for a granted fact - where the other five are `name_or_identify`. On E4 the group splits on a stated test: where the four options are four unrelated facts that must each be checked, the structure is `several_independent_checks` (q093 four events against one phase, q095 four hormones, q096 four disease agents); where one named feature or mechanism settles the whole option set, it is `single_step` (q091's $\mathrm{H^+}$ secretion, q092's named bioassay, q094's choanocytes). q091 alone is `explanatory_reasoning` because it asks what accounts for what; the rest are `recall` of taught associations. The two negated members, q093 and q095, each carry `true_statement_trap` on every option that is true of the subject, applied the same way in both. `elimination` is carried only by q094, where one printed feature - the collar cells - strikes out three options by itself.
